SELECT date, COALESCE( i.unmber, 0 ) inflowMoney, COALESCE( o.unmber, 0 ) flowOutMoney FROM ( SELECT adddate( date_add( LEFT(#{payTime}, 10 ), INTERVAL - DAY( LEFT(#{payTime}, 10 )) + 1 DAY ), numlist.id ) AS 'date' FROM ( SELECT n1.i + n10.i * 10 + n100.i * 100 AS id FROM num n1 CROSS JOIN num AS n10 CROSS JOIN num AS n100 ) AS numlist WHERE adddate( date_add( LEFT(#{payTime}, 10 ), INTERVAL - DAY( LEFT(#{payTime}, 10 )) + 1 DAY ), numlist.id ) <= date_add( date_add( LEFT(#{payTime}, 10 ), INTERVAL - DAY (LEFT(#{payTime}, 10 )) + 1 DAY ), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) ) temp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sum( cast(money as decimal(18, 2)) ) unmber, LEFT ( pay_time, 10 ) AS udate FROM px_bookkeeping_record r LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_classification c ON r.type = c.id WHERE c.type_difference = '0' AND r.del_flag = 0 AND LEFT( r.pay_time, 7 ) = LEFT( #{payTime}, 7 )
AND r.create_by IN
#{uid}
GROUP BY udate ) i ON temp.date = i.udate LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sum( cast(money as decimal(18,2)) ) unmber, LEFT ( pay_time, 10 ) AS udate FROM px_bookkeeping_record r LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_classification c ON r.type = c.id WHERE c.type_difference = '1' AND r.del_flag = 0 AND LEFT( r.pay_time, 7 ) = LEFT( #{payTime}, 7 )
AND r.create_by IN
#{uid}
GROUP BY udate ) o ON temp.date = o.udate ORDER BY temp.date

SELECT c.type_parent_id id, p.type_icon icon, p.type_name name, sum(cast(r.money as decimal(18, 2))) value FROM px_bookkeeping_record r LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_classification c ON r.type = c.id left join px_bookkeeping_classification p on c.type_parent_id = p.id WHERE r.del_flag = 0 AND c.del_flag = 0 AND c.type_difference = #{typeDifference} AND LEFT( pay_time , 7 ) = LEFT(#{date} , 7)
AND r.create_by IN
#{uid}
GROUP BY c.type_parent_id

SELECT c.id, c.type_icon icon, c.type_name name, sum(cast(r.money as decimal(18, 2))) value FROM px_bookkeeping_record r LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_classification c ON r.type = c.id WHERE r.del_flag = 0 AND c.del_flag = 0 AND c.type_difference = #{typeDifference} AND LEFT( pay_time , 7 ) = LEFT(#{date} , 7)
AND r.create_by IN
#{uid}
GROUP BY c.id

SELECT a.id, a.account_icon icon, a.account_name name, sum(cast(r.money as decimal(18, 2))) value FROM px_bookkeeping_record r LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_account a ON r.account = a.id LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_classification c ON r.type = c.id WHERE r.del_flag = 0 AND a.del_flag = 0 AND c.del_flag = 0 AND c.type_difference = #{typeDifference} AND LEFT( pay_time , 7 ) = LEFT(#{date} , 7)
AND r.create_by IN
#{uid}
GROUP BY a.id
